theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_pf_normal_closure
theorems.statement: (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → (X - Y).support ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support ∧ IsCompact (X - Y).support ∧ (X - Y).mass < ∞ ∧ boundaryMassOn (X - Y) univ < ∞) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), IsCompact X.support → X.boundary.support ⊆ X.support ∧ IsCompact X.boundary.support ∧ boundaryMassOn X.boundary univ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
